rendered: The DFT simulation gives a change in intercalation energy of ∼75 meV[1] for an in-plane strain of +1.5%[2]. The measured change in potential was ∼40 mV[3] at an in-plane prestrain of ∼1.66%[4]. The paper calls the computed change comparable to the measured change; the ratio of computed to measured change is 1.88[5], calculated by dividing the DFT change by the measured change.
